input.title: 2027 Hobie Cat Wave Sailboat
input.descriptionHtml:
We are sold out for the 2024 season. Please reach out to be placed on our 2025 waiting list, or ask about any other available catamarans we may have.

Not Arriving for the 2026 season. We hope to re-stock in 2027.

The Hobie Club Wave is an easy- to-sail, easy-to-rig speedster that will have you smiling. Fun for the family and exciting for the juniors while forgiving enough for the newly initiated, the Hobie Wave is the ideal must-go-sailing-now catamaran.

The symmetrically shaped hulls and keel design provide lift while eliminating the need for daggerboards, and its rotomolded polyethylene construction is nearly indestructible. Equipped with thoughtful features including a comptip mast and Hobie Bob mast float to prevent turtling if capsized. A large, fully-battened, boomless mainsail is powerful in the light stuff, but is designed to reduce power in an unexpected gust. The three-piece mesh trampoline is heat melded for the ultimate in longevity, has two main sections and is simple to adjust.

SPECS:
Crew: 1-4
Length: 13' / 3.96 m
Beam: 7' / 2.13 m
Capacity: 800 lbs/362 kg
Weight: 245 lbs / 111 kg
Draft w/ Rudder Up: 11" / 0.28 m
Mast Length: 20' / 6.09 m
Sail Area: 95 ft / 9.0 m
Hull Construction: Rotomolded Polyethylene
Height From Floor to Bow: 18.5" / 46.99 cm
Height From Floor to Stern: 25.25" / 64.13 cm

2 Part Mast with Comptip Hobie "Baby Bob" Bora Bora Boomless Sail 4:1 Mainsheet Block System Eva Deck Pads Mesh Trampoline EZ-Loc Rudders
